name: Outblog AI
author: taicdevshare

sections.description:
Scale Organic Traffic on Autopilot

Outblog is an AI-powered content automation engine built for WordPress. It continuously researches keywords, generates high-quality SEO articles, and syncs them directly to your website—without manual effort.

No topic research.
No writing.
No publishing workflows.

Outblog works silently in the background as your always-on content team, helping your site stay fresh, relevant, and optimized for modern search engines.

The Outblog plugin may embed external references or credits within generated articles where relevant.

The plugin also provides secure API access that allows the Outblog platform to retrieve your published posts for content analysis, optimization, and performance improvement.

Features

  • Fully automated content creation and keyword research
  • AI-generated SEO-optimized articles
  • Supports 150+ languages
  • Seamless one-click WordPress integration
  • Media-rich articles with images, videos, and citations
  • Brand voice and tone customization
  • Long-form content support (up to 4,000 words)
  • Smart publishing cadence with automatic syncing
  • Multi-site and team-ready support

External Services

This plugin connects to the Outblog API to fetch AI-generated blog content and to retrieve published posts for analysis and optimization.

Data sent:
* API key (stored securely in plugin settings)

Data is sent when:
* Manual sync is triggered
* Daily automatic sync runs via WordPress cron

External services:
* Outblog API: https://www.outblogai.com
* Privacy Policy: https://www.outblogai.com/privacy-policy
* Terms of Use: https://www.outblogai.com/terms-of-use
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  3. Navigate to Outblog → Manage in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Enter your Outblog API key and choose your publish mode (Draft or Publish).
  5. Click Sync Articles to fetch content instantly, or allow daily automatic sync via cron.
sections.faq:
Does Outblog automatically publish articles?

Yes. You can choose whether articles are saved as drafts or published immediately.

How does the syncing work?

Outblog securely syncs unique AI-generated articles to your WordPress site and ensures no duplicates are created.
